Tell us about your requirements of VR app development, expected project duration, key skills, and qualifications of the VR developer(s) you are looking for. Frequently Asked Questions

What types of VR projects can be covered by your expert developers of virtual reality?

We are doing our best to provide experienced developers to work with any VR technologies you may need. Our skilled developers are adept in creating different applications tailored to a variety of industries and use-cases. From game development, training simulations, architecture, healthcare, marketing, and event management – to VR integration services, support & maintenance, VR prototyping / design, and custom VR development, we can get you covered.

What are the benefits of hiring a dedicated VR developer from Mobilunity?

Possessing 14+ years of experience delivering high-quality staffing solutions, we not only find and bring you the best talents. Mobilunity is all about a client-centric, and proactive approach – resulting in greater speed, flexibility, and satisfaction, both for companies working with us and development specialists we are recruiting. When you hire virtual reality developers from us, you get a reliable and cost-effective talent solution tailored to the unique configuration of your project, get professionally trained developers and also save time and money to hire.

How much does it cost to hire VR developers for our project?

We offer virtual reality developers at cost-effective rates. Your price estimate will depend on the composition of the team of VR app developers, their skill set / tech stack, level of seniority, and years of experience in the relevant domain. Another important factor is the cooperation model – you may opt for building a team of dedicated VR developers, hiring a single software expert full-time / part-time, or engaging a tech consultant for a maximum focused and flexible approach. Tell us about the scope (duration) of your project, and your requirements of VR technology – and we will give you a cost estimate, and advise you on the optimal hiring option / team composition tailored to your needs.

How quickly can you provide experts for my VR project?

The quick answer is – you can hire offshore virtual reality developers within 2-6 weeks. The actual time for finding and hiring VR developers for your project depends on the complexity of your requirements and the engagement model of your choice. To build a dedicated team from ground zero, it will take us at least 4-6 weeks. For project-based / part-time collaboration, we can usually complete your request within 2-3 weeks. As for tech consulting, our advisors may be at your service within 2 weeks, as it commonly doesn’t take too much time for onboarding or deep integration with your team / development process.

How do you check the expertise of VR experts you’re hiring?

Putting quality service and customer satisfaction on top, we handle a rigorous screening and pre-vetting process. Analysis of relevant technical skills, and proficiency in VR tools and frameworks, is done by professionally trained developers and interviewers. We carefully examine experience in the domain, soft skills (creative problem-solving capabilities, communication, culture), and practical assignments. Eventually, every candidate we bring in front of you comes with a detailed report, scoring, and in-depth feedback from related tech specialists – so that you can make a fully informed decision.

Do you offer any support after the VR experience is deployed?

Yes, once your VR project goes live, you might want to get any type of post-deployment support and technical assistance. Our VR developers are capable of handling the full scope of application maintenance, performance / security enhancements, ongoing feature releases / content updates, bug fixes, troubleshooting, and all-around technical support tailored to business needs that our developers have already been working on.

What are the best headsets that are most popular for VR apps for different industry sectors?

Given that potential users are looking for primary factors like affordability, compatibility, and feature-rich experience, there are several VR headsets that are focused by VR application developers as well. We can recommend the following headsets: Oculus Rift, Oculus Go, Oculus Quest, HTC Vive, Samsung Gear VR, Daydream. Each of these headsets caters to specific use cases, from gaming and entertainment to professional simulations and enterprise applications.

How do you manage different time zones when hiring remote VR developers?

When you hire experienced developers or software consultants from Mobilunity, you can expect clear communication and smooth collaboration with minimal disruptions. Our clients can hire virtual reality developers who are used to working with the industry-standard PM and daily communication tools (e.g. GitHub, Slack, Trello), relying on an Agile approach and SCRUM-based development. You may want to completely eliminate the time zone differences, so we can find a great match for you from different nearshore or closely proximate locations across the globe.
